body: Make a playful editorial image of a hand holding a {{drink}} against a bright ivory background. Render the hand, condensation and glass as a sharp studio photograph. Overlay sparse black ink doodles: a tiny imaginary swimmer in the drink, an expressive face on the garnish, a few loose bubbles and energetic curved lines. The drawing should interact clearly with the photograph while remaining visibly hand drawn. Leave open space for a headline, but add no text.

instructions.en: No reference image is needed. Copy the full prompt into your image generator.
instructions.zh-Hans: 无需参考图，将完整提示词复制到图像生成工具即可。

en.title: Drink photography with ink doodles
en.description: A real-looking lemonade and hand meet playful black ink swimmers, bubbles and a smiling lemon.
en.body:
## How to use

Change the drink but retain condensation and the contrast between photography and ink. Leave the background open if you intend to add a headline later.

## Recorded result

The default was generated with the built-in image tool. The precise provider model ID was not returned. Other values are not yet tested.
